about: Tags a state DOT's open data gives OpenStreetMap ways that carry none, by way id, for pavement no name or ref tie can reach (an unnamed way). Each entry is checked against the DOT's own data and is applied only where the way has `when`'s tags and lacks every key it sets: never over OSM's own value, and harmless once OSM has it. Read by tile.mjs (the road tiles) and names.py (the road-name index). format/names.md.

entries.source: NCDOT State Maintained Roads (NC OneMap open data, gis11.services.ncdot.gov NCDOT_StateMaintainedRoadsQtr): RouteName SR-1544, StreetName 'N Halifax Rd' (RouteID 40401544064 / 40001544064, Nash County 064, project B-5980), from NC-4/NC-48 at 36.06271,-77.81946 to the I-95 exit 145 roundabouts. Every listed way lies within 7 m of the NCDOT line; OSM has them trunk, unsigned_ref SR 1544, no name (noname=yes on five). The permit prints 'SR-1544 / N Halifax Rd' there (app trip c45df15b)
